_comment: Dispatch offline Phase 5 hardening — contractual-text parity between the web signing page and the phone's inert local page. `agreement` is the frozen payload (identity computed independently in Python). `visible_text`: every phrase a reader of the web page sees; the phone must show every one. `phone_also_shows`: wording the phone shows although a browser would not (a blocked remote image's alt text). `never_visible`: text neither page shows (script output, template, noscript under scripting, iframe fallback, SVG <title> tooltip). `probe`: the global any executed content would set — it must stay undefined on the phone. `approvals_required`: checkboxes both pages render. `web_content_html`: Laravel's own render (TermsAgreement::contentHtml), pinned by the backend test. Sanitization is presentation only: the identity never changes.
